_comment: Older 3.x instance native saved before some messenger tables existed: no messenger tables at all (no alexa/sayit/telegram/... keys) and no custom table.

Derived from 3.1.2 admin/lib/index_m.js save() and createArray(): the linkedDevice.finalIds entry only carries the messenger lists that existed at save time (here only telegram, referencing a row that is not stored any more; no matrix/discord/signal/email keys).
3.1.2 main.js reads devicesInput[messenger].length for every messenger, so missing lists must be treated as empty. status.ids is empty (stateAction etc. fall back to the defaults).
